name: Tbilisi State Medical University
overview: Tbilisi State Medical University (TSMU), founded in 1918, is the oldest and largest medical university in Georgia and the Caucasus region. With over a century of history, TSMU is renowned for its academic excellence, advanced research, and comprehensive medical training. The university has produced more than 40,000 doctors and healthcare professionals, many of whom serve in leading positions worldwide. TSMU offers a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and allied health sciences. The university boasts modern infrastructure, including state-of-the-art laboratories, simulation centers, and partnerships with top hospitals for clinical training.

TSMU is highly regarded for its international outlook, attracting students from over 70 countries. Its degrees are recognized globally, enabling graduates to pursue medical careers or further studies in countries such as the US, UK, India, and throughout Europe. The university’s commitment to affordable education, multicultural environment, and strong academic support makes it a preferred destination for aspiring doctors.
whyChoose: International Recognition: TSMU is recognized by the World Health Organization (WHO), National Medical Commission (NMC, India), Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG, USA), World Federation for Medical Education (WFME), and FAIMER. Its degrees are globally accepted, allowing graduates to practice medicine worldwide after meeting local requirements.

Affordable Tuition and Living Costs: Compared to Western Europe and North America, TSMU offers high-quality education at a fraction of the cost, making it accessible to students from diverse backgrounds.

Modern Infrastructure: The university features recently renovated campuses, advanced laboratories, simulation centers, and digital libraries, providing students with the latest tools for medical education.
Experienced Faculty: TSMU’s faculty includes highly qualified professors and researchers, many with international experience, ensuring students receive world-class instruction.
Diverse Student Body: With 25–26% international students, TSMU offers a multicultural environment and support services, including language courses and cultural integration activities.
Comprehensive Clinical Training: Students gain hands-on experience in leading hospitals and clinics across Georgia, preparing them for real-world medical practice.
Strategic Location: Located in Tbilisi, Georgia’s vibrant and safe capital, students enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, affordable living, and rich cultural opportunities.
Strong Research Focus: TSMU is dedicated to medical research and innovation, offering students opportunities to participate in research projects and conferences.

name: Caucasus University

It is housed in a historic building with modern infrastructure, making it one of the largest and most advanced campuses in Georgia and the Southern Caucasus. The university is committed to providing a multicultural environment, fostering research, critical thinking, and practical skills, and preparing students for global careers. With state-of-the-art facilities, a vibrant student life, and a faculty composed of highly qualified professionals (many with international experience), CU offers a dynamic and supportive learning environment.

name: Ilia State University
overview: Ilia State University (ISU), established in 2006 in Tbilisi, is Georgia’s flagship public research university and the top-ranked higher education institution in the country according to Times Higher Education and SCImago Institutions Rankings. ISU emerged from the merger of six academic institutions, bringing together a rich legacy of research, innovation, and academic excellence. With over 16,000 students and 1,200+ staff, ISU is recognized for its integration of teaching and research, commitment to academic freedom, and the unity of liberal and specialized education.

ISU’s School of Natural Sciences and Medicine offers a globally recognized 6-year Medicine (MD/MBBS) program, accredited by WHO, NMC, WFME, and ECFMG, ensuring that graduates are eligible for medical licensing and practice worldwide. The curriculum is comprehensive, blending theoretical knowledge with extensive practical and clinical training at more than nine partner hospitals and clinics in Tbilisi. ISU boasts state-of-the-art facilities, including advanced laboratories, simulation centers, and a technologically advanced library. The campus is vibrant, with extensive sports and recreational infrastructure, student clubs, and cultural activities fostering a well-rounded student experience.

ISU is a leader in internationalization, with over 700 international students from 67 countries and partnerships with 125 universities across Europe and beyond. The university’s strong alumni network, affordable tuition, and living costs, as well as its supportive, multicultural environment, make it a preferred destination for international medical aspirants

name: David Tvildiani Medical University
overview: David Tvildiani Medical University (DTMU) is one of the most prestigious and internationally recognized private medical universities in Georgia, established in 1989. DTMU is renowned for its English-medium MD program, which strictly follows US and European medical education standards, making it especially popular among international students. The university’s AIETI Medical School is the only institution in Georgia to offer its entire medical curriculum in English, and its graduates consistently achieve high success rates in international licensing exams such as USMLE, PLAB, and NMC FMGE.

DTMU’s curriculum is fully integrated, problem-based, and clinically oriented, with early exposure to patient care and extensive hands-on training in affiliated hospitals. The faculty comprises experienced professors and practicing clinicians, and the university maintains a low student-to-teacher ratio for personalized attention. The Rustavi campus, a recent addition, provides advanced research, learning, and recreation facilities, including secure, modern hostels with Indian food options and 24/7 surveillance.

DTMU is globally accredited and recognized by WHO, NMC (India), WFME, ECFMG (USA), FAIMER, and more. The university’s strong international partnerships, affordable tuition, and supportive multicultural environment make it a top choice for aspiring doctors worldwide. Graduates are eligible to practice medicine or pursue postgraduate training in the US, UK, India, and many other countries.

name: Akaki Tsereteli State University (ATSU)
overview: Akaki Tsereteli State University (ATSU), founded in 1930, is one of the oldest and most respected public universities in Georgia, located in the city of Kutaisi. With more than 10,000 students and over 5,000 academic staff, ATSU is a multidisciplinary institution that offers a broad spectrum of academic and professional programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels. The university is internationally recognized for its high academic standards, innovative teaching, and strong research orientation, and it maintains active collaborations with leading universities and scientific centers in the EU, USA, and Eastern countries.

ATSU’s Faculty of Medicine is especially popular among international students for its 6-year English-medium MBBS (MD) program, which is accredited and recognized by WHO, NMC (India), WFME, ECFMG, and FAIMER. The program combines five years of theoretical and practical education with a compulsory one-year clinical internship, ensuring graduates are well-prepared for global medical practice. The university’s modern infrastructure includes advanced laboratories, simulation centers, a large library with over one million volumes, and on-campus hostels with all necessary amenities.

ATSU is known for its affordable tuition fees (USD 4,500/year for MBBS) and low living costs, making it a top destination for students seeking quality education on a budget. The university provides a vibrant international student environment, with support services, career counseling, and opportunities for extracurricular engagement. Over its long history, ATSU has produced more than 65,000 graduates who have gone on to successful careers worldwide.
